name: Clean Temporary Files
description: Removes temporary files from the Windows temp directory and user temp folder. Frees disk space by deleting stale installer caches, log files, and application temp data.

params.rollbackCommand: echo 'Temp files cannot be restored after deletion'

rollback.command: echo 'Temp files cannot be restored after deletion'

name: Clean Thumbnail Cache
description: Deletes the Windows thumbnail cache (iconcache*.db and thumbcache_*.db files). Frees disk space and forces regeneration of fresh thumbnails. Useful when thumbnails appear corrupted.

params.applyCommand: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Remove-Item -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\thumbcache_*.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\iconcache*.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process explorer

apply.command: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Remove-Item -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\thumbcache_*.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\iconcache*.db" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process explorer

name: Flush and Optimize DNS Cache
description: Flushes the DNS resolver cache and restarts the DNS Client service. Removes stale DNS entries and forces fresh resolution. Can resolve connectivity issues.

params.rollbackCommand: echo 'DNS cache will rebuild from network queries'

rollback.command: echo 'DNS cache will rebuild from network queries'

name: Clean Windows Update Cache
description: Stops the Windows Update service, clears the downloaded update cache (SoftwareDistribution folder), and restarts the service. Frees significant disk space when old updates accumulate.

params.applyCommand: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv
params.rollbackCommand: echo 'Windows Update cache cannot be restored; updates will re-download as needed'

apply.command: Stop-Service -Name wuauserv -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path 'C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name wuauserv

rollback.command: echo 'Windows Update cache cannot be restored; updates will re-download as needed'

name: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Empties the Recycle Bin for all drives. Permanently deletes all files that were previously sent to the recycle bin, freeing disk space immediately.

params.rollbackCommand: echo 'Recycle Bin contents cannot be restored after emptying'

rollback.command: echo 'Recycle Bin contents cannot be restored after emptying'

name: Delivery Optimization Cache Size
description: Reports how much disk the Delivery Optimization cache is using. Windows shares update files through this cache, so Novimize measures it rather than deleting it: files already removed by Windows Update cannot be put back, and the cache refills on demand anyway. The size is only readable from an elevated session, so unelevated runs report 0.

params.detectCommand: $path = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'ServiceProfiles\NetworkService\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization'; $ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $path -Recurse -File -Force 2>$null; $total = ($files | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; if ($null -eq $total) { $total = 0 }; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0; Write-Output $total; exit 0
